objectClass.notes: The open cargo end and shafts must occupy the same end. Reversing them destroys the reference structure and is not a camera issue.

reasoning: The long shaft silhouette, unequal wheel sizes and arched canopy create a strongly directional multi-scale object.
A credible wagon requires real axle, steering, spring, spoke, hub, floor, wall, canopy and cargo structures rather than a decorated box.
The reference exposes a partially occluded interior, so open-end orientation and attachment order require independent main and side review.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Complex depth is required by the running gear, four wheel assemblies, fabric support system, open cargo bay and long hitch structure.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Hidden underside joinery is inferred from axle and frame contact.
The canvas is a controlled arched surface rather than cloth simulation.

details.description: Cream waxed canvas forms one continuous arched shell with a visibly softened ridge.
Five dark bent hoops and raised seams divide the canopy into readable bays.
The shaft end is open beneath a rolled canvas flap secured by two leather straps.
Three side plank courses sit on a separate nine-plank floor with projected upper caps.
Vertical oak posts, black corner straps and paired rivets reinforce every body edge.
Four wheels use separate iron tires, wooden felloes, fourteen spokes and deep hubs.
Each hub has two worn-iron collars and projected linchpins.
The front axle is separated by an iron turntable ring and brass kingpin.
Layered curved iron spring lines bridge the rear axle and longitudinal frame.
Two long tapered oak shafts converge slightly and carry iron tip bands and a crossbar.
A hinged iron ground support and foot hold the empty shafts above grade.
A side brake lever, linkage, leather grip and rear step remain visibly separate.
Two slatted crates, a gathered burlap sack and rope coil fill the open bay without sealing it.
A guarded amber lantern hangs from a short chain at the open cargo end.
Raised seams, edge hems, side lashings and stitched repair patches break the clean fabric field.

anatomy.note: Object domain; character anatomy is not applicable.

definitionOfDone: Open cargo end, long shafts, four credible wheel assemblies, canvas bay rhythm and layered running gear remain readable in main and independent long-side views.

qualityCriteria: Long shafts, arched canopy and unequal wheel pairs read immediately.
Axles, steering turntable, springs, hubs and spokes are separate contact structures.
Opening, rolled flap, cargo and lantern align with the hitch end.
Oak, canvas, iron, rope, leather and burlap respond independently.

antiShallowSpecRules: No solid vehicle box or four cylinder wheels may pass.
The cargo opening may not be placed opposite the horse shafts.
Canvas may not be a flat roof slab.
